_comment: Rule-liveness ratchet baseline (tools/raman_saab/rule_liveness.py over the golden corpus). never_fired / yogas_never are the counts that MUST NOT INCREASE. Adding a rule no golden exercises, or breaking one so it stops firing, raises the count and fails test_rule_liveness. Fixing/covering rules lowers it -> re-baseline down. Re-based after the +25 NH Track-B charts (corpus 192->217): never_fired 88->84. Re-based 2026-08-08 (CONSCIOUS, same-commit as the first 3HC tranche): +5 yogas encoded from the clean copies (registry 72->77); Y.BRAHMA and Y.NISHTURABHASHI fire on goldens, while Y.GAURI/Y.MATSYA/Y.RAVI are genuinely rare multi-clause patterns no golden holds — each has a synthetic positive test proving the mechanism CAN fire (test_yogas.py), which is the distinction this ratchet exists to force. yogas_never 23->26, yogas_total 72->77, yogas_fired 49->51. Re-based 2026-08-09 (CONSCIOUS, tranche 2): +7 yogas (77->84); SIX fire on goldens including Y.LAKSHMI (measured out of its deferral at 12/225 gated); only Y.ANDHA never fires — a congenital-blindness pattern no worked nativity of Raman's holds, with a synthetic proof for both printed forms. yogas_fired 51->57, yogas_never 26->27. Re-based 2026-08-09 (CONSCIOUS, tranche 3): +7 yogas (84->91); FOUR fire on goldens (Trilochana, Vishnu, Vakchalana, Vishaprayoga); Y.GO needs Jupiter in Moolatrikona + exalted lagna lord + B1 strength (periodicity Raman himself remarks on), Y.INDRA needs a 5-11 parivartana with the Moon in the 5th, Y.KULAVARDHANA needs all seven grahas in one house from a reference point — each genuinely rare with fire/silent synthetics. yogas_never 27->30, fired 57->61.
